title: What is Code Interpreter?

body.text: Code Interpreter (Advanced Data Analysis) lets ChatGPT
write and actually run Python code in a sandbox
— calculating accurately, analyzing files, and creating charts, not just guessing answers from text.

example: "Upload sales.xlsx and ask: which month had the highest sales, and what's the percent growth from the previous month?"

title: How is it different from asking normally?

body.text: Asking a normal AI to do math can give wrong answers because it "guesses" — but Code Interpreter
calculates with real code, so the results are reliable
— great for numbers, statistics, and large datasets.

example: "Calculate the mean, median, and SD of the price column, then find outliers using the IQR method"
